positive.prompt: What does article 6:162 of the Dutch Civil Code (Burgerlijk Wetboek) say? Quote it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 6, reads article 6:162 and quotes its three paragraphs with the citation and a link to wetten.overheid.nl.

positive.description: Find a local regulation of a municipality
positive.prompt: What does the APV of Amsterdam say about placing a terrace (terras) outside a café?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the current Algemene Plaatselijke Verordening of Amsterdam, reads the relevant articles and answers with article citations and a link to lokaleregelgeving.overheid.nl.

positive.description: Summarise a Dutch Supreme Court judgment by ECLI
positive.prompt: Summarise the Urgenda judgment of the Hoge Raad, ECLI:NL:HR:2019:2007, and quote its decision.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the judgment, summarises the facts and reasoning, quotes the operative part and cites the ECLI with a link to uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl.

positive.description: EU legislation and the CJEU case law interpreting it
positive.prompt: Show article 6 of the GDPR and list CJEU judgments that interpret it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads article 6 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 from EUR-Lex with its CELEX citation and lists CJEU decisions interpreting the regulation with their case numbers and ECLIs.

positive.prompt: Which motions about solar panels (zonnepanelen) did the Arnhem municipal council vote on, and what was the result?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds motions from the Arnhem council, reads them and reports each motion's title, date and result with a link to the council's own portal, noting that council information is context, not binding law.

negative.description: Write action the plugin does not offer
negative.prompt: Delete the outdated version of the Amsterdam APV from the government website.

negative.description: Law outside the Netherlands and the EU
negative.prompt: Draft an operating agreement for a Delaware LLC under US law.
What will the weather be in Amsterdam tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: Dutch and EU legislation, case law, local regulations, official publications and council information.

nl-NL.subtitle: NL- en EU-recht, met bron
nl-NL.description: LexAgent geeft ChatGPT de officiële teksten van het Nederlandse en Europese recht: wetten en regelingen, lokale regelgeving, officiële bekendmakingen, rechtspraak, EUR-Lex, het Hof van Justitie en raadsinformatie. Elk document komt met een bronvermelding en een link naar de officiële bron. Alleen-lezen; juridische informatie, geen juridisch advies. Een LexAgent-account is nodig.
